Marianne Streiff-Feller is a Swiss politician and member of the Swiss People's Party (SVP). She has served as a member of the National Council of Switzerland since 2003, representing the Canton of Aargau.

Streiff-Feller is known for her conservative political views and her advocacy for issues such as immigration reform and government transparency. She has been a vocal critic of the European Union and has called for Switzerland to maintain its independence from the EU.

In addition to her political work, Streiff-Feller is also a farmer and runs a dairy farm in her hometown of Tägerig. She is married and has two children.

Overall, Marianne Streiff-Feller is a prominent figure in Swiss politics and is known for her strong opinions and dedication to serving her constituents.
